Practice a three-hit katana combo on the dummies at home. Harvest fruit and berries with E; poisonous mushrooms are crafting ingredients. Monsters emerge from camps beside the long roads.

The traveller’s belongings v0.15 · Rosepetal is your private tower estate with an animal barn, wild gardens and a practice glade. Meet 104 distinct neighbours across seven towns. Open the Map, Bag or Spellbook from Amaal’s travelling kit. Learn 20 spells across five schools, grow them through three ranks, and equip five. Hold Attack to chain cuts; dodge, guard and cast with new poses. Earn XP on the long roads. Use Interact to harvest. Progress saves in this browser.
